title: THE LOW ALARM ONLY SOUNDS NEAR YOU AND SAYS WHAT IT IS
why: His note: an annoying low siren plays in the background too often, and he does not know what it means. It is the alarm cue, raised by about twenty things, and machines far away fighting pillagers raised it all raid long. It now sounds only within 700 of you, at most once every 4 seconds, and the feed says MACHINE ALERT each time.
now: The low alarm now only sounds when a machine near you is alerted, at most every 4 seconds, and the feed says MACHINE ALERT.
